messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-02-06 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-02-06-2]
- As of 2026-02-03, the Atlas team does a no-deploy Friday. [decision; valid 2026-02-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2026-02-03]
- As of 2025-12-05, the Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. [valid 2025-12-05 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting]
- As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-27 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-27-notifier-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-06-11, the Cinder team owns the notifier, which the Boreal team owned until then. [valid 2025-06-11 to 2025-06-27; recorded by handover/2025-06-11-notifier]
    earlier: The Boreal team owns the notifier. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-06-11; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09-2]

- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhook dispatcher delivered some events twice on 2026-02-20. [valid 2026-02-26 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the job scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-16. [valid 2026-05-19 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- INC-2025-023 was an indexer incident on 2025-10-03 in which the indexer served stale results for two days. [valid 2025-10-07 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2025-023]
- As of 2025-12-19, the Atlas team owns the product catalog, which the Cinder team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-12-19 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-19-catalog]
    earlier: The Cinder team owns the product catalog. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-19; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-11-24, the Atlas team looks after the bus, which the Boreal team looked after until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-24 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-24-event-bus]
    earlier: The Boreal team looks after the bus. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-11-24; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-09]
- As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-03-09 to now; recorded by handover/2026-03-09-feature-flags-correction]
    earlier: As of 2026-02-11, feature-flags is owned by team Dune, which the Ember team owned until then. [valid 2026-02-11 to 2026-03-09; recorded by handover/2026-02-11-feature-flags]
    earlier: As of 2025-11-06, feature-flags is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [valid 2025-11-06 to 2026-02-11; recorded by handover/2025-11-06-feature-flags]
    earlier: feature-flags is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-11-06; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2025-11-26, the image resizer is owned by the Atlas team, which the Ember team owned until then. [decision; valid 2025-11-26 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-26-image-resizer]
    earlier: The image resizer is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-11-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-image-resizer]
    earlier: team Dune owns the image resizer. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then. [decision; valid 2026-01-12 to now; recorded by handover/2026-01-12-billing-api]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [decision; valid 2025-07-03 to 2026-01-12; recorded by handover/2025-07-03-billing-api-correction]
    earlier: From 2025-06-09, the billing API is owned by the Boreal team. [valid 2025-06-09 to 2025-07-03; recorded by handover/2025-06-09-billing-api]
    earlier: Since 2025-03-07, the billing API is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-03-07 to 2025-06-09; recorded by handover/2025-03-07-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing API is owned by the Atlas team. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-07; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08-2]
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz holds the Dune on-call shift for team Dune, taking over from Farah. [decision; valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22]
- Team Dune adopted a monthly game day. [valid 2025-04-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-21]
- Team Dune sits on the fourth floor. [valid 2025-07-24 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-07-24]
- The reporting service is owned by team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]
- The team Dune planning meeting is every Wednesday. [valid 2026-05-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-05-22-4]

Question: Which services does Dune own now?

message.reasoning:
We need to find which services team Dune owns now (2026-06-30).

Let me go through memory entries:

1. Reporting: As of 2025-12-05, Ember team owns reporting, which team Dune owned until then. So Dune no longer owns reporting. But there's also "The reporting service is owned by team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20-2]" — this is conflicting. The handover entry (2025-12-05) supersedes? The rule says later entry supersedes earlier one on the same subject. The handover/2025-12-05-reporting is later (recorded later?) — the valid-from dates: handover valid 2025-12-05 to now; standup valid 2025-01-20 to now. Both claim "now". The handover says Ember owns reporting as of 2025-12-05. The standup says Dune owns reporting. The recorded dates: handover recorded by handover/2025-12-05-reporting (recorded presumably 2025-12-05 or later), standup recorded 2025-01-20. Later entry supersedes earlier on same subject. So Ember owns reporting now, not Dune.

2. Notifier: As of 2025-06-11, team Dune owns the notifier (valid 2025-06-27 to now). So Dune owns notifier.

3. Job scheduler: Cinder owns as of 2025-09-23. Not Dune.

4. Product catalog: Atlas owns. Not Dune.

5. Bus: Atlas. Not Dune.

6. Feature-flags: Atlas as of 2026-03-09 correction. Not Dune.

7. Image resizer: Atlas. Not Dune.

8. Billing API: Ember. Not Dune.

So currently Dune owns: the notifier. Possibly reporting is contested; per supersession rule, Ember owns reporting.

Answer: the notifier.
